result.title: Measuring Layer-wise Intrinsic Dimensionality of FFNs in LLMs via PCA
result.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables
result.summary: Modern large language models (LLMs) keep the feed-forward network (FFN) intermediate width identical across every layer, a convention inherited from the original Transformer. Yet mechanistic work suggests layers at different depths do qualitatively different work, raising a natural question: are their capacity demands also non-uniform, and if so, can a fixed parameter budget be allocated more wisely than uniformly? To probe this, we apply principal component analysis (PCA) to the input of each FFN down-projection and measure, for every layer, its intrinsic dimensionality as the smallest number of principal components needed to reconstruct the activation up to a fixed cosine similarity. Scanning 58 open-weight LLMs spanning 14 families and 70M to 72B parameters, we find a recurring middle-heavy profile in which middle layers carry higher intrinsic dimensionality than edge layers; the profile is robust to the calibration corpus, even across English and Chinese, and is largely preserved through post-training fine-tuning. As a direct test that this signal is structurally meaningful, we use it to guide width pruning in a knowledge-distilled student under a matched parameter budget: the PCA-guided allocation outperforms the uniform-width convention by +2.3 points on Qwen3-8B and +2.5 on Qwen2.5-3B, while lower-dispersion teachers show smaller gaps (+0.9 on Gemma-3-4B, +0.5 on LLaMA-3-8B), and a budget-matched inverted control does worst on all four teachers. Across these four teachers, the size of the gap tracks how unevenly the teacher's intrinsic dimensionality is distributed across layers (a single-number summary we call $σ_{99}$), and the advantage persists through downstream supervised fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/lidf.

AI.brief_summary: 对 58 个开源 LLM 每层 FFN 下投影输入的激活做 PCA，以固定余弦相似度重构所需的主成分数作为内在维度，发现「中层高、两端低」的稳定剖面，并用该信号在等参数预算下指导宽度剪枝，优于均匀宽度分配。
AI.relevance_reason: 这种逐层内在维度的 PCA 度量可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的表示容量与几何分布，中层高维剖面也可能与预测工作区类假设相关；但论文是纯文本 LLM 分析与结构剪枝，与视觉证据或多模态推理状态尚无直接联系，其度量能否迁移到跨模态激活仍需核查。
